messages.chronicle.summary: Print the chronicle of a day: the Steward's file, or one built on the spot from the event log when there is none (writes nothing)
messages.chronicle.option.day: The kingdom's local day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today)
messages.chronicle.live_note: No {file} yet: this one was built on the spot from the event log, and no file was written.
messages.chronicle.heading: # Chronicle of {name} · {day}
messages.chronicle.machine_note: The machine wrote this part from the event log; no model wrote it and it spent no mana.
messages.chronicle.empty: Nothing to tell of this day: no quest done, returned, sealed, sent to the infirmary or delivered; no verdict, no level gained or lost, no pool asleep or awake.
